d: In this video, I travel to Mogadishu, the capital of Somalia, often called one of the most dangerous cities in the world. My journey begins in Yakutsk and crosses three continents, flying from Yakutsk to Moscow, then Addis Ababa, and finally Mogadishu. After decades of civil war and instability, Somalia remains one of the least visited places on Earth. In this vlog, I explore the ground reality of Mogadishu, a city known for its strategic location, history of piracy, and complex past.
